title: Still Ours? — Cross-Linguistic LLM Code-Painting Instrument and Worldview Archive
description: Open-source projective code-painting instrument (p5.js 1.11.13; MIT License) and cross-linguistic worldview dataset (CC BY 4.0) probing 28 queried model endpoints (27 verified frontier and retiring language models, 2024–2026; OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Alibaba Qwen, Moonshot Kimi, Zhipu GLM, Mistral; 1 retired alias mistral-large-2407 flagged identity_verified=false and excluded from reference statistics) across English, Chinese, and French without image-diffusion models. Includes 1,365 released Love and Death runs (540 contemporary flagship runs: 270 Death in Bitcoin block #974,473 and 270 Love in Bitcoin block #975,705; plus 825 longitudinal historical runs across 19 endpoints anchored in Bitcoin blocks #976,612, #976,629, and #976,634), a 30-call thinking-switch crossover on Claude Opus 4.8 and Opus 5 anchored in Bitcoin blocks #976,766 and #976,778, and time-stamped SHA-256 hash manifests covering 2,295 total runs (including 900 embargoed historical runs on forthcoming chapters). Full-resolution 1600x2000 PNGs and raw response bundles for released chapters (Love and Death only; unreleased chapters include SHA-256 hash manifests only) will be deposited separately (DOI forthcoming).
